meta.title: Plans
meta.description: Lists every plan this Session submitted for review, newest first — in the right sidebar and on a page beside Chat. A composition bar and counters split the plans by outcome, chips filter the list, and a click on a card opens the plan in the built-in viewer: the list itself never draws one. Plans are read from the Session log: exit_plan_mode calls, and ExitPlanMode calls in imported Claude Code Sessions. The plugin only reads the Session, never writes to it, and needs no approvals. Open it from the sidebar guide or the Plans view in the header.
